description:
Cancel an open offer or counter on the trade ledger.

Only the parties involved in a trade may cancel it. The active wallet signs
the cancellation with BIP-137 to prove authorization.

Requires an unlocked wallet with Bitcoin keys.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

inscription_id.description: Inscription ID (must match the trade being cancelled)

name: ordinals_p2p_cancel
